tools.purpose: Camunda linting, FEEL, templates, and selected cluster operations
Java workers, connectors, tests, or local Camunda runtime
Run Node utilities and npm packages

external_requirements: A running compatible Camunda cluster and its chosen profile/credentials are needed only for engine operations. Local linting and drafting do not need a cluster.
Agent connectors, authenticated accounts, provider permissions, and project configuration use the existing session. Package installation does not authenticate or grant write authority.
Docker Desktop must be running for container workflows. Tool installation does not start the daemon or prepare project-specific images.
